reconfigure.title: Warsaw Public Transport
reconfigure.description:
**This configuration uses the City of Warsaw’s old API ({current}).**

The City's old API has stopped answering, so this line gets no timetables until you replace the key with a token. We recommend switching to the new API, which requires a token.

To switch to the new API:

1. Get a token from [dane.um.warszawa.pl/pl/key-api]({portal}).
2. Paste it into the field below.

Your line and stop settings will be preserved.

merged_keys.title: Line {line}: shared credentials selected
merged_keys.description:
**The stops on line {line} used different API keys or tokens.**

The stops have been grouped into one configuration, so the whole line now shares one set of credentials. If a stop had a saved token, that token was selected. Otherwise, the key from the oldest configuration was kept.

If data are no longer available for a stop, open the integration and choose **Configure** for this line to enter the correct API key or token.

You can dismiss this notice.
